risk_signals: new invariant relied on by compaction
units.reason: New watermark function decides which series compaction may evict; a wrong value could lose samples.
units.headline: New committedAppendID returns highest append ID guaranteed committed
units.summary: Adds isolation.committedAppendID, which under appendMtx read lock returns the sentinel's last issued ID when no appenders are open, otherwise the lowest open appendID minus one, and 0 when isolation is disabled. compactHeadViewLocked captures it before writing blocks and passes it to the evictors, so series with samples above it are kept in the head.
focus: That appendsOpenList stays sorted ascending (newAppendID appends at the tail), so .next is the lowest open ID
That samples carry their appendID only after the series write in Commit, before closeAppend, so <= watermark implies visible in every later block snapshot
Disabled-isolation path returns 0: evictors must treat 0 as 'skip the append-ID check', not 'evict nothing'

units.reason: New test-only code that pins the committedAppendID contract; it cannot affect production behavior.
units.headline: Tests for committedAppendID with open, closed and disabled appenders
units.summary: New subtests cover disabled isolation, a fresh isolation, all appenders closed, one or more open appenders with out-of-order closes, and an open read state. They exercise the real isolation type with no fakes, so a line-by-line review is not needed.
